gloss: wild; wildlife; growing in the wild

definitions.gloss: wild; wildlife; growing or living in the wild
definitions.explanation: The state of animals or plants living naturally without human cultivation or domestication. Also used as a modifier to describe something that exists in its natural, untamed state.

examples.japanese: {野生|やせい}の{鹿|しか}を{見|み}かけた。
この{花|はな}は{野生|やせい}で{育|そだ}ったものだ。
examples.english: This flower grew in the wild.

examples.japanese: {野生|やせい}{動物|どうぶつ}に{餌|えさ}を{与|あた}えてはいけないと{看板|かんばん}に{書|か}いてあった。
examples.english: A sign said that you must not feed the wild animals.

notes:
A compound of {野|や} (field, wild) and {生|せい} (life, living). Used both as a noun and as a no-adjective modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野生|やせい}{動物|どうぶつ} (wild animal)
- {野生|やせい}{植物|しょくぶつ} (wild plant)
- {野生|やせい}の～ (wild ~)
- {野生|やせい}に{返|かえ}る (to return to the wild)
- {野生|やせい}{生物|せいぶつ} (wildlife)

The opposite of {野生|やせい} is {飼育|しいく} (breeding, raising in captivity) for animals or {栽培|さいばい} (cultivation) for plants. {野生|やせい} can also be used figuratively to describe someone with raw, untamed energy or instincts: {野生|やせい}の{勘|かん} (wild instinct).
